City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
JUNE 2, 2022 -
6:00
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
Item 8A is located in the Coastal Zone, the Coastal Development Permit is under the California Coastal Commission Jurisdictions. The action of the Planning Commission relative to Item 8A may not be appealed to the California Coastal Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner, or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROJECT NAME: La Costa 48 Tentative Map Modification; CASE NUMBERS: MULTI-005412-2022; SUB-004952-2021; SUBC-005413-2022 FILING DATE: November 1, 2021; APPLICANT: Brian Ardolino; LOCATION: 510, 512 & 514 La Costa Avenue (APNs: 216-030-10, 45 & 46); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Public hearing to consider a modification to an approved Tentative Map-Density Bonus (TMDB) and substantial conformance to an approved Design Review (DR), to address requirements by the California Coastal Commission. ZONING/ OVERLAY: The project site is located within the Residential-3 (R-3) zoning district, within the following overlays: Coastal Appeal Jurisdiction of the Coastal Zone, Cultural/Natural Resources, Hillside/Inland Bluff & Scenic Visual Corridor; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: In accordance with Section 15164 of the California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines, an addendum to the previously certified Environmental Impact Report has been prepared.
STAFF CONTACT: Nick Koutoufidis, Senior Planner: (760) 633-2692 or nkoutoufidis@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval
La Costa 48 Tentative Map Modification
Correspondence (06-02-2022)

CONTINUE REVIEW AND CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENTS TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION BYLAWS.
STAFF CONTACT: Anna Colamussi, Planning Manager: (760) 633-2724 or acolamussi@encinitasca.gov
Direct staff to return with a resolution reflecting amendments, if any, to the bylaws approved by the Planning Commission.
